claims.statement: For every finite bipartite graph H, vertex set W, a=alpha(H), and integer 1<=k<=a, if q_j counts independent j-sets meeting W, then k*q_(k+1)<=2*(a-k)*q_k.
claims.scope: All finite bipartite simple graphs H, all W subseteq V(H), and 1<=k<=alpha(H).
claims.reason: Double-count tagged deletion-extension pairs; each tagged (k+1)-set has at least k tag-preserving deletions, and each tagged k-set has at most 2*(alpha(H)-k) extensions by the bipartite independence-number bound.

claims.reason: Identify the deletion difference with q_p-q_(p-1), apply C2-T3-01 with k=p-1 when p>=2, and handle p=1 separately from the guard, which forces G=K2.
